about: Origin marks of this unit's data. sourced: taken from the credited source, only its format or coordinates converted; derived: made from sourced data by a fixed rule; adapted: source content changed by judgement (pixels erased or filled, plates joined, a sourced name replaced); made: no source content (new drawings, drafts, stroke timing, name boxes); unknown: not recorded. A figure field resolves as figures[id][field], then default[field], then unknown; a field a figure does not have (no drawing, no name box) is not listed. names and readings list every entry; "*" is the file's own default name.
